summary: Join our dynamic team as a sourcing professional to contribute to our growth and success. We are looking for talented individuals who share our passion for high-quality products and excellent customer service.
responsibilities: Source premium products across various categories of Home Furnishing
Manage relationships with vendors in India, Nepal, and Bangladesh
required_skills: Knowledge of sourcing processes and procedures
Analytical skills to track growth and sales data
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
nice_to_have_skills: Experience in the retail industry or e-commerce
Familiarity with international trade laws and regulations
Knowledge of Indian market trends and consumer behavior
benefits: Opportunities for career growth and professional development
Comprehensive health insurance and employee assistance programs
Flexible working hours and remote work options
